# NEW 2026-11-22 v15.5 Stars of East Asia — Korea Sea/Land Yearly Hook & Story Dispatcher (oe_kr2_) (0 vanilla overrides, 0 mainline slots). Generated by gen_v155_east_se_asia.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Zero-slot yearly kernel hook (called from oe_gk_yearly_dispatch once per year globally).
oe_kr2_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_kr2_ran_y ?= current_year } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_kr2_ran_y value = current_year }
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:KOR
				c:KOR = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					num_locations > 0
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						NOT = { oe_rule_is_global_arcs_player_only = yes }
					}
				}
			}
			c:KOR = { oe_kr2_story_tick = yes }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: fires at most one oe_kr2 historical event per yearly tick.
